data.headline: Medtronic | Engineering Manager
data.about:
A seasoned professional with over two decades of qualitative experience in Automotive & Industrial Product Design & Development & Program Management.

Responsible for leading multiple programs (New Product Development, New Technology Introduction, Sustenance & Engineering To Order) for mechanical subsystems/systems in automotive and industrial products domain. 

Balanced professional on the leadership competencies, focus on results, interpersonal skills and leading change

An innovative thinker with in depth knowledge in product design, development, testing and validation. Excellent knowledge about engineering tools DFMEA, DVP, DRBFM. In depth knowledge about New Product Development & New Technology Processes.

Hands on experience in developing the engineering teams from start (hiring, competency development, coaching and mentoring, aligning the teams towards meeting business goals etc.) 

Hands on experience in managing teams in a matrixed environment. Experience includes talent acquisition, competency development, performance management, budget planning, managing stake holders etc.

Demonstrated experience on global product releases throughout the entire new product development cycle.

Hands on experience in developing and managing engineering centers (managing operations, managing the organization compliances etc.)

description.text:
As Head of the Surgical Instruments R&D Center of Excellence, I manage multidisciplinary teams driving innovation across New Product Development (NPD), Value Engineering (VAVE), Application Engineering, and Simulation. 

Generate cost optimization ideas for stapling and energy portfolios by conducting structured VAVE workshops involving cross-functional teams.

Established robust governance frameworks, project review processes, and execution metrics, enhancing cross-functional collaboration, project transparency, and accountability across global teams.

Built and scaled an advanced Modeling & Simulation team, expanding expertise in structural, nonlinear, dynamic, and CFD analyses. This has enabled early risk identification, improved design robustness, and accelerated product development timelines.

Consistently delivered NPD milestones with over 90% on-time execution, supporting design verification, risk management, and product lifecycle objectives.

experiences.title: Senior Engineering Manager & Legal Entity Director/Site Lead
experiences.subtitle: Club Car . Full-time
experiences.caption: Jul 2021 - Jan 2025 · 3 yrs 6 mos

description.text:
Established and led operations of newly formed Club Car India legal entity by setting up a new technical center, mechanical engineering lab, HR & finance functions. Oversaw end-to-end site operations.
  
Implemented third-party support services for payroll and compliance, ensuring smooth and efficient administrative functioning.
  
Built and scaled a highly capable engineering team in India, delivering New Product Introduction (NPI), Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE), and sustaining projects remotely.
  
Led the global VAVE function, achieving $10 million in cost savings and developing a strong project pipeline of $24 million, Built AOP and managed CAPEX and OPEX across the global VAVE portfolio, ensuring all initiatives remained within budget.
  
Delivered multiple Electric Vehicle NPD projects with responsibility of E2E subsystem design ownership. Ensured deliverables met agreed quality, deliver and cost (QDC) targets.
  
Developed a strategic roadmap and governance structures for the India engineering team. Championed talent development and performance management, enhancing employee satisfaction and retention.

subComponents.title: General Manager and Legal Entity Director - Club Car Business Unit
subComponents.caption: Jun 2021 - Jun 2021 ·

description.text: Promoted to the role of General Manager and Legal Entity Director to lead Club Car Business Unit separation.

subComponents.title: Engineering Manager - Club Car Business Unit
subComponents.caption: Sep 2017 - Jun 2021 · 3 yrs 9 mos

description.text:
Built and scaled the India engineering team from the ground up, starting with VAVE and expanding into NPD, Sustaining Engineering, Custom Solutions, and FEA capabilities.

Delivered multiple Electric Vehicle NPD projects, took ownership of E2E design of subsystems and delivered the projects with QDC>90%. Led global VAVE initiatives, delivering $2 million in annual savings and creating a $6 million pipeline.

Designed and implemented a multi-year maturity model to elevate team competencies and ensure strategic alignment with Club Car’s global technology roadmap and business goals.

subComponents.title: Technical Manager - Club Car Business Unit
subComponents.caption: Jan 2016 - Aug 2017 · 1 yr 7 mos

description.text:
Built and scaled a high-performing engineering team to lead Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE) initiatives for the Club Car Business Unit, establishing India as a key global engineering hub for cost optimization.

Led the global VAVE portfolio, delivering $2M in annualized cost savings while building a $6M pipeline of validated cost-reduction opportunities across multiple product platforms.

Established a robust VAVE governance framework with standardized project reviews, financial tracking, and executive reporting, improving portfolio visibility, accountability, and benefits realization.

subComponents.title: Lead Engineer - Power Tools Business Unit
subComponents.caption: Feb 2015 - Dec 2015 · 10 mos

description.text:
Led Product Innovation initiatives, driving end-to-end New Technology Introduction (NTI) activities for pre-New Product Development (Pre-NPD) programs.

Owned the complete innovation lifecycle from requirements definition, technology scouting and competitive landscaping, concept selection, and feasibility assessment through Proof of Concepts (PoCs), maturing designs for successful transition into NPD.

subComponents.title: Senior Engineer - Power Tools Business Unit
subComponents.caption: Feb 2011 - Jan 2015 · 3 yrs 11 mos

description.text:
Worked as “Senior Engineer” in the Power Tools Business Unit at Ingersoll Rand, My key roles and responsibilities were.

Lead NPD projects for pneumatic tools from concept through launch. Led design activities including concept development, detailed engineering, DFMEA, and DVPNR, while coordinating cross-functional reviews and supporting gate review milestones. Provided hands-on support for manufacturing and post-launch phases, including product testing, assembly build support, and resolution of field issues through FRACAS.

Lead value engineering workshops and competitive benchmarking to identify cost reduction opportunities while maintaining product performance and quality.

Designed and developed interior and exterior trims for Tavera and GM Spark facelift programs, aligning aesthetics with functional and safety requirements to meet market expectations.

Collaborated with the Industrial Design team to create CAS models, and coordinated with suppliers for part development and tooling, ensuring manufacturability and quality during the product lifecycle.

Supported vehicle testing and performed detailed packaging and ergonomic studies to optimize spatial layout, improve comfort, and enhance the overall user experience.

Led Vehicle Architecture group, delivering General Assembly, Vision, and GCIE drawings with On-Time Delivery (OTD) and First-Time Right (FTR) scores exceeding 90%, ensuring high engineering efficiency.

Perform virtual competitor product benchmarking thru GCIE (Global Car Manufacturers Geometrical Information Exchange) Platform

Executed ECNs and ECRs to support New Product Development, creating design concepts and releasing manufacturing drawings.

Collaborated with FEA teams to validate structural and functional requirements through simulation and contributed to DFMEA reviews for risk mitigation.

Optimized product designs using value engineering, achieving cost reductions without compromising quality or functionality.
